ideas.title: The Minnesota Child Care Fraud Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the fraud in Minnesota's child care program and identify those responsible
ideas.angle: Follow the money: track the flow of funds and identify potential shell companies or other entities involved in the fraud
questions: What was the extent of the losses?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota child care fraud scandal has the potential to reveal widespread corruption and abuse of government funds. A deeper dive into the scandal could uncover a complex web of entities and individuals involved in the fraud.
